scripts.start: vp run --filter web build && electrobun dev
scripts.dev:hmr: vp run --filter web build && concurrently "bun run hmr" "electrobun dev --watch"
scripts.build: vp run --filter web build && electrobun build
scripts.build:stable: vp run --filter web build && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.build:canary: vp run --filter web build && electrobun build --env=canary
